_readme: Posts for @RealBlitzOdds. scripts/social-verify.mjs (run by .github/workflows/social-verify.yml) renders each post against the live odds endpoint the night before it's due, checks `requires`, and schedules it in Buffer only if every assertion holds; otherwise it tries `fallback`, and if that fails too it leaves the slot empty and emails alertEmail. Placeholders: {{fav:AWAY-HOME}} {{spread:G}} {{ou:G}} {{time:G}} {{network:G}} {{line:G}} {{biggest:N[:Day]}} {{closest:N[:Day]}} {{countGte:X}} {{topFavs:N}} {{maxTotal[:Day]}} {{slot:TIME}} {{slotCount:TIME}} {{dow}}. Assertion kinds: fresh, weekOdds, spreadEq, spreadGte, spreadLte, favorite, maxTotal, countGte, kickoff, dayHasGame, siteContains. dueAt is Eastern with its UTC offset (-04:00 through Nov 1, then -05:00).

Your top confidence points belong on the games you'd feel dumb missing, not the ones you're excited about.

One week of results is one data point.

The team that looked awful in Week 1 is still the roster the market liked in August. Lines move a point or two, not seven. Don't let one Sunday flip your whole confidence sheet.
